text:
raj: Kicking off DUB2 private cluster commissioning — target: air-gapped customer site, GPU pool 'saturn-rtx', final handoff by EOD PST. Need oncall + delivery to validate network and quotas.

natalie: copying checklist here, adding MTU and BGP sanity. main constraints: 1) provider limits on /22 in eu-west, 2) GPU quota 128 total, 3) customer firewall only allows outbound 443/8443.

kai: FYI I already prebuilt the seed image (v2026-03-10) and uploaded the tarball to the secure drive. It's signed with our internal key. Will share sha256 in a sec.

maria: @kai drop the sha and the exact rpm list pls, ops team will run validation before handoff. We need nvidia-driver 535.xx and cuda 12.2 pinned.

kai: sha256: f2b1c9d3a4e6e9c5b8a1a7d6c3f4b9d2f1e6a7c9b2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3

raj: Network preflight command (run from on-prem bastion):
```bash
# check MTU and route to provisioning proxy
ip link show eth0 && ip route get 8.8.8.8
# test http proxy reachability
curl -I --proxy http://10.10.10.2:3128 https://packages.example.com/seed/v2026-03-10.tar.gz
```

dave-oncall: ran the MTU check earlier, hosts on customer vlan are 1400 MTU, need to set tunnel to 1400 as well or we see packet fragmentation on large kernel modules. Putting this in the runbook step. :warning:

ops-bot: [artifact-scan] seed-image v2026-03-10 signed OK, no critical CVEs in pinned rpms.

natalie: GPU quota flow: we will allocate 80 GPUs to saturn-rtx pool initially (g4dn.12x equivalent), keep 48 as spare for other clusters. If customer needs burst, we have a reserved burst of 24 on Dedicated — policy: auto-fallback to dedicated if provisioning latency > 7m.

maria: Validation commands after nodes join:
```bash
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep saturn
# check nvidia device plugin
kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep nvidia
# run simple stress test
kubectl run gpu-test --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/k8s/cuda-sample:vectoradd --restart=Never --limits=nvidia.com/gpu=1 -- sleep 30
```

kai: Quick note on airgap: we use a staging proxy appliance that mirrors apt/yum repos. Ensure /etc/hosts on seed has these entries, example:
```text
10.200.0.5 packages.local
10.200.0.6 container-registry.local
```

raj: Also watch for BGP next-hop rewrite we saw in SEA2 last month — if the customer's edge rewrites next-hops, internal control-plane heartbeats fail. Preflight BGP: ask customer to advertise the /24 and confirm no next-hop normalization.

dave-oncall: During earlier run I saw kubelet crashlooping on node saturn-03 due to wrong docker overlay MTU. Fix: set --node-ip and --network-plugin-mtu=1400 in kubelet.service and restart. Logged steps to incident tracker.

maria: Cost callout: pinning 80 GPUs in region adds ~15% to monthly commit vs dynamic burst — we've documented cost tradeoff and the customer accepted initial premium for predictable latency. Include cost sheet link in the handoff.

raj: Handoff checklist (to delivery):
1) Confirm seed image signature and sha.
2) Confirm MTU and route table entries.
3) Confirm BGP advertisement and no next-hop rewrite.
4) Run node join + device plugin + gpu-test above.
5) Snapshot cluster state: `kubectl get all --all-namespaces -o yaml > dub2-initial-state.yaml` and upload to secure ticket.
6) Share kubeconfig with customer service account (rotate token after 24h).

natalie: tagging @dave-oncall to run the snapshot and @maria to prepare the cost handoff doc. After validation we'll mark this thread resolved.

deploy-bot: Deploy job `saturn-seed-provision` started at 2026-03-10T14:12:00Z — logs streaming to secure-logs.

maria: All good from my side, preparing final slide with latency and cost buckets. Will post link when ready. :thumbsup:

raj: Thanks team — if any blocker appears ping me directly. I'll stay on the channel until handoff.
